options_sched_desc.message: Run a saved prompt every day at a set time, with nobody watching. Scheduling pre-approves its plans; sensitive actions are automatically declined, an unattended task can read and report, never spend. Results land in the side panel history, with a notification when each run finishes.

options_firewall_howItWorks.message:
The firewall contains a deny list and an allow list.
If both lists are empty, all URLs are allowed
Deny list takes priority - if a URL matches any deny list entry, it's blocked
When allow list is empty, all non-denied URLs are allowed
When allow list is not empty, only matching URLs are allowed
Wildcards are NOT supported yet
Allow list is preferred over deny list
